title: Time Jump — 06:40, Hospital on Paper

fields.narration: It is now 06:40 on Tuesday, March 3, 2026. The Hospital Incident Command (HCC) has been open for 20 minutes. The entire hospital is operating on paper charts. The ISO has disabled the compromised svc-ehr-admin account and isolated the EHR database servers ORRMC-SQL01 and ORRMC-SQL02. The managed detection service is actively scanning the network for lateral movement. The Emergency Department holds 27 patients, and two ambulances are en route. The 07:30 surgical cases are now less than an hour away.
worldState: The hospital is operating under EHR Downtime Procedures (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026)
The EHR database servers ORRMC-SQL01 and ORRMC-SQL02 are isolated and unresponsive
The managed detection service is conducting a network-wide forensic sweep
The ED census is 27 patients, with two ambulances on the way
The 07:30 surgical cases are delayed by 45 minutes
The Incident Action Plan (IAP) for the second operational period is now in development
The HCC is operating under EOP Level 1 (Full activation)
The Policy Group (CEO, COO, CMO, CNO, General Counsel) has been informed and is in coordination
fields.facilitatorNote: This jump confirms the full activation of HCC and sets the stage for the next IAP cycle. Monitor for decisions on the 07:30 surgeries and the ED surge.
